locked_identity.policy: identity-only visual input; never modify, replace or use rejected descendants as visual input

product_flow_truth.menu_enter: A short acknowledgement expression hands off to the separate no-face four-root menu UI. It is not a face with a hamburger/menu icon.
product_flow_truth.recording_active: The character listens and captures incoming sound. Sound direction is external source/microphone to character, never mouth output.
product_flow_truth.charging_active: The real product charging connector attaches at the bottom of the Companion. The daily face remains above a compact bottom-attached connector and restrained energy rises from the connection; no dangling cable, battery, or lightning-only art.

event_overlay_architecture.daily_base: The locked V9 daily component stack remains visible and retains deterministic eye/highlight, brow and mouth micro-choreography. It is not replaced by a functional full-face source.
event_overlay_architecture.decoration_policy: A decoration is a registered art-derived component with a named semantic trigger and deterministic entry/hold/release sequence. It supplements eye/brow/mouth performance and never substitutes for it. Every later functional state uses this daily-face-plus-overlay grammar instead of requesting a replacement facial card.

functional_overlays.recording_active: A compact art-derived microphone or sensor plus inward capture pulses plays beside the daily/listening face. The pulse direction is environment to character, never speaking output.
functional_overlays.charging_active: A compact art-derived connector seated at the bottom of the daily/restorative face plus upward energy pulses plays below it. The attachment is physical and bottom-oriented, never a dangling cable, battery, or lightning-only badge.
functional_overlays.menu_enter: A very brief acknowledgement micro-beat may use the daily face and an existing registered sparkle, then it hands off to the accepted no-face menu UI.

affect_decoration_matrix.primary_performance: Every family uses the directed affect graph and deterministic eye/highlight, brow and mouth choreography first; decorations only arrive after the facial response or as a compact causal event overlay.

motion_grammar.owner_confirmed_layering: One locked V9 character has two coordinated layers: the emotion layer is primarily the eyes/highlights, brows and mouth; the state layer is a compact, character-bound semantic decoration. A state decoration must not replace, freeze or become the emotion face.
motion_grammar.owner_confirmed_liveness: A held emotion remains visibly alive through a small deterministic performance, led by eye/highlight motion and answered by brows and mouth. It is not a static sticker, random twitching, or a repeating sequence of complete face cards.
motion_grammar.owner_confirmed_change: Changing emotion is a causal component bridge from the held source emotion to the held target emotion. The face resolves first and the eligible decoration arrives last; crossfades, filters and whole-face replacement are forbidden.
motion_grammar.vertical_daily_gaze_guard: For daily_up and daily_down, each paired primary highlight and smaller sparkle stays on the pure vertical axis at x=0, moves only one y pixel per score step, and never exceeds y=-2 or y=+2 respectively. This is stricter than source-eye containment so the reflection group reads as an internal gaze movement rather than a white block escaping the eye.
motion_grammar.paired_eye_reflection_guard: Within every Daily score step, the dominant source-derived highlight and smaller source-derived sparkle of the same eye carry exactly the same current offset. The black V9 eye body remains fixed. The pair can lead the other eye by a beat, but its two white reflections never split, counter-move or leave one another pinned to the source anchor.
motion_grammar.daily_gaze_clearance_guard: The locked V9 static center is immutable. Dynamic Daily uses the owner-preferred down=(0,2) paired-reflection position as its internal rest anchor after exact entry and before exact settle. Attention is a small relative offset from that anchor: left=(-1,2), right=(1,2), up=(0,1), down=(0,2). No score intermediate may be more peripheral than its registered rest-anchor route. Directional readability is answered by causal brow, mouth and cheek response rather than expanding the eye travel.
motion_grammar.daily_dynamic_rest_anchor: The original V9 (0,0) reflection layout is an identity entry/settle invariant, not the continuously held Dynamic Daily gaze center. Both source-derived reflections move together from entry to rest=(0,2); all directional holds remain close to this ordinary resting gaze.
motion_grammar.face_primary_emotion_inventory: V9 currently has open and sleepy eye bodies, paired open-eye reflections and the default mouth. Accepted inactive V22 contributes distinct calm, curious, warm, playful, puzzled and alert brows/mouths/cheeks while keeping V9 open eyes. New lid or eye-body forms require a separately versioned V9-only image-source and component gate; code drawing or geometric distortion is forbidden.

iteration_protocol: Record every owner steering decision in companion_product_requirements.md before implementation.
Record the prompt delta and source-reference policy in a versioned request and prompt before image generation.
Use only the locked V9 image with image_gen.imagegen for a new art source; never use rejected descendants as visual input.
Render a label-hidden native 200x200 composed preview immediately after generation: the locked daily baseline plus the proposed overlay where the source is an event component.
Freeze any rejected attempt with exact feedback and prohibit visual-reference reuse.
Only a passing source proceeds to component extraction, deterministic choreography, browser/target parity, machine closure and canonical owner review.

decision_log.reason: Abstract tabs, cuffs and tether did not tell a first-time viewer what the character was doing.
Improved direct readability but used a false hamburger menu story, output speech arcs and a wired charging metaphor.
Menu transition was correct, but recording microphone and wired charging connection fell outside the normalized target canvas.
Facial performance improved, but the microphone and wireless dock were placed outside the normalized native-200 component-safe area.

The owner replaced dedicated functional-face generation with a living V9 daily baseline plus deterministic event-overlay components. No V33 revision-4 source is allowed to enter the repository or visual lineage.
The source showed a free-standing wireless cradle but omitted the owner-confirmed bottom-attached charging connector.

Native 200 preview showed a curious question competing with the inherited daily sparkle, an alert stem that degraded into an unbalanced thin mark, and a dream cloud competing with inherited sleep moon-and-Z art. Its sources are audit-only and forbidden as visual reference or runtime components.

V9-only question, exclamation and dream-cloud sources passed the native-200 source/component choreography gate. Each state reconstructs the V9 face from registered components with mutually exclusive inherited charms omitted by selection; it remains unavailable to CRIG, firmware and panel claims pending later gates.

Owner reconfirmed that eye/highlight, brow and mouth carry changing emotion; compact decorations communicate state context; each held emotion has deterministic micro-presence; and different emotions use a visible component transition rather than filters, whole-face swaps or random switching.

Owner found the daily_up and daily_down primary highlights visually reaching the eye edge. Vertical gaze is now constrained to a pure, one-pixel-per-step internal movement from zero to plus or minus two pixels, shared by browser and target scores.

Owner found that the smaller white sparkle remained pinned while the dominant highlight moved. Each eye now moves its two source-derived reflections as one constrained gaze group, while the black V9 eye body remains fixed.

Owner found daily_down closest to the earlier normal V9 reading while other holds felt too peripheral. The static V9 center remains fixed; daily_down supplies a source-mask eye-rim-clearance reference for re-centering the other paired-reflection holds.

decision_log.iteration: Daily measured gaze calibration and face-primary refinement 2026-07-20
decision_log.reason: Mask measurement selected smaller legal paired-reflection holds instead of the former eye-rim positions. Owner also set eye/lid, brow and mouth expression as the primary next refinement: use accepted V22 brow/mouth diversity now and require versioned V9-only source art before adding unavailable eye-body vocabulary.

Owner found the earlier safe-range score still visually anchored every direction to the wrong source-center. The normal-looking down pose is now the internal dynamic rest anchor; the locked source-center frame remains exact at entry and settle only.
